title: Surface growth and foliage generation
summary: Derive branch paths from a bounded surface or shape, preserve deterministic growth identity, and generate branch geometry plus late-bound foliage instances.

use_when: the requested form requires growth paths or branch hierarchy

inputs: prepared growth surface with masks, scale, normals, and obstacle policy
acceptance: paths remain in the allowed region
branch identity and hierarchy are deterministic
rollback: one graph Undo group when supported
preserve the original input and masks
